devour_core.title: Devour Core
devour_core.description: Absorbed abilities radiate outward by Pokemon type.

tackle.title: Tackle
tackle.description: Charge forward and stop when your body slam connects with the first enemy.

quick_attack.title: Quick Attack
quick_attack.description: Dash forward in a burst of Normal energy at close range. Can be used twice before recharging.

swift.title: Swift
swift.description: Launch a volley of Normal projectiles from long range.

tri_attack.title: Tri Attack
tri_attack.description: Fire three homing blasts that may burn, chill, or paralyze their target.

recover.title: Recover
recover.description: Focus your energy to restore a large amount of health.

hyper_voice.title: Hyper Voice
hyper_voice.description: Channel a wide cone of Normal energy at medium range. Knocks enemies back and interrupts casting. Takes a short moment to cast.

hyper_beam.title: Hyper Beam
hyper_beam.description: Charge a devastating piercing beam, then become Exhausted after firing.

ember.title: Ember
ember.description: Flick a small ember at an enemy and set them ablaze.

flame_charge.title: Flame Charge
flame_charge.description: Dash forward in flame. Hitting an enemy briefly increases your movement speed.

flamethrower.title: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: Hold to breathe a stream of fire. It starts recharging when you release it.

fire_spin.title: Fire Spin
fire_spin.description: Create a swirling Fire vortex from long range. Sets enemies ablaze.

fire_blast.title: Fire Blast
fire_blast.description: Launch a Fire blast from long range that explodes on impact. Sets enemies ablaze. Takes a short moment to cast.

fire_punch.title: Fire Punch
fire_punch.description: Swing a fiery fist in front of you and set struck enemies ablaze.

overheat.title: Overheat
overheat.description: Release a broad blast of flame that burns enemies and leaves you Exhausted.

water_gun.title: Water Gun
water_gun.description: Unleash a piercing Water beam at medium range. Soaks enemies and knocks enemies back.

aqua_jet.title: Aqua Jet
aqua_jet.description: Dash forward in a burst of Water energy at medium range. Soaks enemies.

bubble_beam.title: Bubble Beam
bubble_beam.description: Launch a stream of bubbles from long range that may slow enemies.

whirlpool.title: Whirlpool
whirlpool.description: Create a swirling Water vortex from long range. Soaks enemies.

surf.title: Surf
surf.description: Send a surging wave of Water energy forward. Soaks enemies.

hydro_pump.title: Hydro Pump
hydro_pump.description: Hold to fire a powerful Water stream that repeatedly pushes enemies back. It starts recharging when released.

thunder_shock.title: Thunder Shock
thunder_shock.description: Fire a quick Electric bolt that can leap to one nearby soaked enemy.

spark.title: Spark
spark.description: Dash with Electric energy. A soaked target conducts damage to another nearby enemy.

electro_ball.title: Electro Ball
electro_ball.description: Launch a crackling Electric orb that hits harder when you outpace your target.

discharge.title: Discharge
discharge.description: Create a lingering cloud of Electric energy at medium range. Paralyzes soaked enemies.

thunder_punch.title: Thunder Punch
thunder_punch.description: Swing an Electric fist that paralyzes soaked enemies without fail.

thunder.title: Thunder
thunder.description: Mark an area for a delayed Electric blast from long range. Paralyzes soaked enemies.

volt_tackle.title: Volt Tackle
volt_tackle.description: Dash forward in a burst of Electric energy at medium range. Deals recoil damage to you, knocks enemies back, and sometimes paralyzes enemies.

vine_whip.title: Vine Whip
vine_whip.description: Strike enemies with a burst of Grass energy at medium range. Pulls enemies inward.

leech_seed.title: Leech Seed
leech_seed.description: Plant a seed that repeatedly drains health from the enemy back to its caster.

razor_leaf.title: Razor Leaf
razor_leaf.description: Launch a volley of Grass projectiles from long range. Sometimes leaves enemies Exposed.

leaf_blade.title: Leaf Blade
leaf_blade.description: Dash forward in a burst of Grass energy at medium range. Sometimes leaves enemies Exposed and hastens you.

giga_drain.title: Giga Drain
giga_drain.description: Briefly channel Nature energy from one enemy and heal for three fifths of the damage dealt.

petal_blizzard.title: Petal Blizzard
petal_blizzard.description: Send a surging wave of Grass energy forward. Knocks enemies back.

solar_beam.title: Solar Beam
solar_beam.description: Launch a devastating blast of Nature energy from long range.

powder_snow.title: Powder Snow
powder_snow.description: Sweep a short cone of powder snow that damages and chills every enemy caught inside.

ice_shard.title: Ice Shard
ice_shard.description: Hurl a razor-sharp shard of Ice from long range that may slow enemies.

icy_wind.title: Icy Wind
icy_wind.description: Sweep freezing wind forward to heavily chill and push enemies back.

ice_beam.title: Ice Beam
ice_beam.description: Hold to channel a piercing Ice beam. Soaked enemies freeze on hit, and recharging starts when released.

ice_punch.title: Ice Punch
ice_punch.description: Swing an icy fist that heavily chills enemies and freezes soaked targets.

aurora_veil.title: Aurora Veil
aurora_veil.description: Raise an icy aurora around you that protects you and nearby allies from damage.

blizzard.title: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Summon a roaming storm of Ice energy. Chills soaked enemies.

mach_punch.title: Mach Punch
mach_punch.description: Dash forward in a burst of Fighting energy at close range. Knocks enemies back. Can be used twice before recharging.

force_palm.title: Force Palm
force_palm.description: Release a close-range palm strike that knocks enemies back and paralyzes nearby targets.

drain_punch.title: Drain Punch
drain_punch.description: Punch a nearby enemy and restore health equal to two fifths of the damage dealt.

seismic_toss.title: Seismic Toss
seismic_toss.description: Grab a nearby enemy and throw it toward your aim. Bosses are staggered instead.

close_combat.title: Close Combat
close_combat.description: Rush an enemy with a rapid Fighting combo at close range. Knocks enemies back and leaves you Exposed afterward.

focus_blast.title: Focus Blast
focus_blast.description: Launch a Fighting blast from long range that explodes on impact. Knocks enemies back and sometimes leaves enemies Exposed. Takes a short moment to cast.

poison_sting.title: Poison Sting
poison_sting.description: Launch a volley of Poison projectiles from long range. Sometimes poisons enemies.

acid_spray.title: Acid Spray
acid_spray.description: Spray a forward cone of acid that poisons enemies and leaves them Exposed.

venoshock.title: Venoshock
venoshock.description: Launch a Poison orb that explodes and deals double damage to poisoned or Toxic enemies.

toxic_spikes.title: Toxic Spikes
toxic_spikes.description: Scatter poisonous spikes across the ground. The first trigger poisons; repeated triggers turn the poison Toxic.

toxic.title: Toxic
toxic.description: Launch a homing toxic droplet whose poison grows stronger as it remains active.

mud_shot.title: Mud Shot
mud_shot.description: Launch a Ground projectile from long range. Slows enemies and leaves enemies Exposed.

bulldoze.title: Bulldoze
bulldoze.description: Send a surging wave of Ground energy forward. Slows enemies and knocks enemies back.

dig.title: Dig
dig.description: Blink behind an enemy and strike with Ground energy at medium range. Knocks enemies back. Takes a short moment to cast.

earth_power.title: Earth Power
earth_power.description: Mark an area for a delayed Ground blast at medium range. Leaves enemies Exposed. Takes a short moment to cast.

earthquake.title: Earthquake
earthquake.description: Strike enemies with a burst of Ground energy at medium range. Knocks enemies back and slows enemies. Takes a short moment to cast.

gust.title: Gust
gust.description: Channel a wide cone of Flying energy at medium range. Knocks enemies back.

air_cutter.title: Air Cutter
air_cutter.description: Launch a volley of Flying projectiles from long range.

aerial_ace.title: Aerial Ace
aerial_ace.description: Blink behind an enemy and strike with Flying energy at medium range.

tailwind.title: Tailwind
tailwind.description: Summon a guiding wind that makes you and nearby allies move faster.

hurricane.title: Hurricane
hurricane.description: Create a swirling Flying vortex from long range. Pulls enemies inward. Takes a short moment to cast.

confusion.title: Confusion
confusion.description: Launch a Psychic projectile from long range. Sometimes disorients enemies.

psybeam.title: Psybeam
psybeam.description: Hold to channel a disorienting Psychic beam. It starts recharging when you release it.

psycho_cut.title: Psycho Cut
psycho_cut.description: Cut the area ahead with Psychic energy that ignores two points of armor.

psychic.title: Psychic
psychic.description: Mark an area for a delayed Psychic blast from long range. Knocks enemies back and sometimes weakens enemies.

rest.title: Rest
rest.description: Fall asleep to fully restore your health and clear harmful effects.

trick_room.title: Trick Room
trick_room.description: Create an inverted room where fast creatures slow down and slow creatures speed up.

future_sight.title: Future Sight
future_sight.description: Mark an area with Psychic energy. After a short delay, it erupts and catches anyone still inside.

string_shot.title: String Shot
string_shot.description: Launch a Bug projectile at medium range. Slows enemies.

pin_missile.title: Pin Missile
pin_missile.description: Launch a volley of Bug projectiles from long range.

u_turn.title: U Turn
u_turn.description: Dash through an enemy with Bug energy, then return to where you started.

x_scissor.title: X Scissor
x_scissor.description: Rush an enemy with a rapid Bug combo at close range. Leaves enemies Exposed.

bug_buzz.title: Bug Buzz
bug_buzz.description: Channel a wide cone of Bug energy at medium range. Leaves enemies Exposed and interrupts casting.

rock_throw.title: Rock Throw
rock_throw.description: Hurl a heavy rock at an enemy from long range.

smack_down.title: Smack Down
smack_down.description: Hurl a homing rock that drags its target down and briefly blocks flight.

rock_tomb.title: Rock Tomb
rock_tomb.description: Raise three temporary rock formations that crush and slow enemies entering the area.

stealth_rock.title: Stealth Rock
stealth_rock.description: Scatter hidden rock traps that damage enemies again whenever they leave and re-enter.

rock_slide.title: Rock Slide
rock_slide.description: Call down a barrage of Rock strikes from long range. Knocks enemies back and sometimes slows enemies. Takes a short moment to cast.

stone_edge.title: Stone Edge
stone_edge.description: Call down a barrage of Rock strikes from long range. Sometimes leaves enemies Exposed. Takes a short moment to cast.

lick.title: Lick
lick.description: Sweep a spectral tongue at close range to paralyze and disorient enemies.

night_shade.title: Night Shade
night_shade.description: Turn an enemy's shadow against it, dealing more damage to targets with greater health.

shadow_claw.title: Shadow Claw
shadow_claw.description: Rend the area ahead with spectral claws that sometimes leave enemies Exposed.

shadow_sneak.title: Shadow Sneak
shadow_sneak.description: Blink behind an enemy and strike with Ghost energy at medium range.

shadow_ball.title: Shadow Ball
shadow_ball.description: Launch a Ghost blast from long range that explodes on impact. Sometimes weakens enemies.

hex.title: Hex
hex.description: Curse an enemy for twice the damage while it is suffering from a harmful effect.

phantom_force.title: Phantom Force
phantom_force.description: Vanish briefly, telegraph your return, then reappear behind the target and strike.

dragon_breath.title: Dragon Breath
dragon_breath.description: Hold to breathe Dragon energy indefinitely without recharging. Your movement is heavily slowed while channeling.

dragon_claw.title: Dragon Claw
dragon_claw.description: Sweep Dragon claws in front of you and launch struck enemies backward.

dragon_tail.title: Dragon Tail
dragon_tail.description: Swing a wide Dragon tail that knocks enemies away and interrupts casting.

dragon_rush.title: Dragon Rush
dragon_rush.description: Steer a Dragon-powered charge whose central impact staggers enemies.

dragon_pulse.title: Dragon Pulse
dragon_pulse.description: Launch a concentrated blast of Dragon energy from long range.

draco_meteor.title: Draco Meteor
draco_meteor.description: Call down a barrage of Dragon strikes from long range. Knocks enemies back. Takes a short moment to cast.

outrage.title: Outrage
outrage.description: Enter a forced sequence of three Dragon charges, then become briefly Confused.

bite.title: Bite
bite.description: Lunge into one enemy. Striking from behind briefly staggers them.

crunch.title: Crunch
crunch.description: Lunge with crushing Dark jaws that sometimes leave the target Exposed.

snarl.title: Snarl
snarl.description: Unleash a Dark sound wave that briefly reduces enemy special spell damage.

dark_pulse.title: Dark Pulse
dark_pulse.description: Channel a sustained Dark beam from long range. Sometimes disorients enemies.

sucker_punch.title: Sucker Punch
sucker_punch.description: Prepare a Dark counter. If an enemy attacks, blink behind them and strike first.

foul_play.title: Foul Play
foul_play.description: Make an enemy's own attack strength determine how hard the shadow strike hits.

bullet_punch.title: Bullet Punch
bullet_punch.description: Flash forward with a Steel punch that ignores two points of armor.

metal_claw.title: Metal Claw
metal_claw.description: Strike twice with Steel claws. Landing both hits grants four Guard.

iron_head.title: Iron Head
iron_head.description: Charge one enemy under a Steel shell and stagger them on impact.

iron_defense.title: Iron Defense
iron_defense.description: Focus Steel energy within yourself. Blocks the next hit.

flash_cannon.title: Flash Cannon
flash_cannon.description: Charge a piercing Steel beam that leaves every struck enemy Exposed.

fairy_wind.title: Fairy Wind
fairy_wind.description: Launch a Fairy projectile from long range. Knocks enemies back.

draining_kiss.title: Draining Kiss
draining_kiss.description: Send a homing Fairy kiss at an enemy and restore health from the damage dealt.

charm.title: Charm
charm.description: Channel a wide cone of Fairy energy at medium range. Weakens enemies.

dazzling_gleam.title: Dazzling Gleam
dazzling_gleam.description: Release a wide burst of Fairy light around you. Also clears Poison or Chill from you.

moonblast.title: Moonblast
moonblast.description: Launch a Fairy blast that explodes across an area and weakens enemies. Takes a short moment to cast.
